cmd.quitarLicencia: Remove Pro licence from this computer
cfg.rutasExtra: Extra folders holding Claude Code transcripts (`.jsonl`). The default locations are always read.
cfg.moneda: Currency used to display the API-equivalent cost.
cfg.cambioEurUsd: EUR per USD, used only when the currency is EUR. `0` keeps amounts in USD.
cfg.tarifasExtra: Your own rates per model, in USD per million tokens: `{"gpt-5.6-sol": {"entrada": 1.25, "salida": 10}}`. Needed for Codex, which has no rate shipped with the extension.
cfg.barraDeEstado: Show the current session in the status bar.
cfg.indexarAlAbrir: Refresh the index when the panel opens.
